why_useful: Useful methodology reference for factor construction, but gated by paid data access we don't have; low direct value for the ABNB pitch.

name: kalshi-price-data
what_it_holds: Advertises Kalshi historical data and a price API: live yes/no prices, full order-book depth, WebSocket streaming, and a Python client (DepthFeed) — appears to be a hosted product with a thin open client rather than committed historical files; needs directory listing to confirm any bundled data vs. pure API wrapper.
why_useful: Kalshi is CFTC-regulated and carries economic-data and event contracts (e.g. CPI, Fed, government shutdown, possibly travel/tourism-adjacent) that are more likely to be well-formed probability series than crypto-native Polymarket; order-book depth would give more than just last price.
size_hint: unclear, likely hosted service not bundled files
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events
